Chapter One — The Mortite Awakening
The Stars Are Burning
For three centuries, humanity explored the galaxy in peace. That ended when the Mortite Order arrived.

Mortimus — a towering black alien warlord, eight feet of cold malice — commands the Void Throne, a Death Star–class dreadnought that blotted out entire star systems. Billions fell in the first wave.

You wake on Haven Prime, the last neutral sanctuary in the sector. Your ship is battered. Your credits are gone. But you are alive.

That is enough to start a war.
